messages.name: anything
messages.description: Sending the name of any device to theobject will set the object to focus on the specified device.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: message will output the current event queue.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: The messagewill reset all values set using theandmessages to their default values.

messages.name: delta
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that represents an element of the device will cause theobject to report an event from the specified element only if it is different then the last value that was reported.

messages.name: ignore
messages.description: The word, followed by an integer that represents an element of the device, disables event reporting from the specified element.

messages.name: info
messages.digest: Print device information to the Max Console
messages.description: Themessage causes device information to be output to the Max console.

messages.name: int
messages.description: An incomingcauses the object to focus on the device in the device list with that index.

messages.name: menu
messages.digest: Output a device list in menu format
messages.description: Themessage causes a device list to be output from the right outlet in a format fit for aobject. On Windows, Onboard and or bluetooth HID devices (keyboards, mouse) are unsupported as available devices.

messages.name: poll
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the time in milliseconds between outputs of the event queue. The message0 disables automatic polling.
